stages.title: Core — ADTs, linear structures, recursion, search and sorting
Transfer — testing, selection and ASOIU integration

competencies.title: Problem modeling and constraints
evidence: identify input/output/constraints/size measure
separate problem requirement from implementation detail

competencies.title: Language-neutral pseudocode and state reasoning
evidence: write unambiguous pseudocode with explicit range/index convention
trace meaningful state transitions

competencies.title: Asymptotic time/space reasoning
evidence: name the input-size measure and derive a bound
distinguish time/space and best/average/worst/amortized meanings

competencies.title: Preconditions, invariants, termination and correctness
evidence: state a precondition and invariant
explain preservation/termination or provide a counterexample

competencies.title: ADT and operation semantics
evidence: separate abstract operations from representation
state operation contract, mutation and complexity assumptions

competencies.title: Array/list/stack/queue reasoning
evidence: choose a linear representation for a workload
trace push/pop/enqueue/dequeue and compare access/update trade-offs

competencies.title: Recursion and call-stack reasoning
evidence: identify base/progress conditions and trace call stack
compare recursive and iterative formulations including space

competencies.title: Search and sorting selection/reasoning
evidence: apply binary search only under valid ordering preconditions
compare sorting algorithms by stability/in-place/case/space requirements

competencies.title: Hashing and associative lookup
evidence: reason about collision/load factor/resizing
distinguish expected lookup from worst-case guarantees

competencies.title: Trees, BSTs and traversal
evidence: preserve BST ordering and reason about height
trace preorder/inorder/postorder and analyze O(n) traversal

competencies.title: Graph model and representation
evidence: distinguish directed/undirected and weighted/unweighted semantics
choose adjacency list or matrix using density/workload

competencies.title: BFS/DFS traversal and reachability
evidence: trace BFS queue/frontier and DFS stack/recursion
justify O(V+E) under adjacency-list assumptions and BFS shortest-path-by-edge-count scope

competencies.title: Algorithm edge-case and property testing
evidence: construct empty/singleton/duplicate/boundary/cycle/collision cases
verify semantic properties instead of one sample output

competencies.title: Algorithm/data-structure selection and trade-offs
evidence: choose a structure/algorithm from workload constraints
justify time/space/precondition/trade-off decisions

competencies.title: Engineering transfer to ASOIU/database/logical-AI contexts
evidence: produce a decision note or small verified artifact
explain where database/AI/domain semantics become external ownership
